title: Checkout slow during Black Friday campaign
symptoms: Request rate went to 3x baseline when the campaign started. CPU at 95% on all replicas, p95 latency over 2 seconds. No deploy.
root_cause: Real traffic growth. Three replicas could not serve the campaign load.
resolution: Restarting did not help. Scaled from 3 to 8 replicas and latency recovered within two minutes.
